scope: small-instance theory-statistic diagnostic; fixed prospectively before these runs
evaluation: every pre-update iterate, all exact diagnostics, separate terminal output
primary_statistic: mean over runs of each full-trajectory arithmetic mean of true smoothed gap
uncertainty: show individual runs or IQR; expectation is estimated from ten stochastic runs of one fixed dataset
replication_rule: Ten stochastic repeats prespecified here, following protocol section12; no extra problem seeds or outcome-triggered repeats.
